# Product photo to video with AI: product ads that keep your real label

**Turn 1-3 product photos into a TikTok, Reels or listing video (unboxing, ASMR, 360 loop, in-hand demo) with the label locked.**

**Typical cost** with `product-photo-to-video`: ~$2.50–10 per 15 s 720p video incl. one repaired shot (estimate). Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay.

<p><a href="../../product-photo-to-video/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_c291f75e56b7.webp" alt="Three product photos of black wireless earbuds become one hero still on a stone pedestal, then a product video where the earbuds float and settle into their case." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`product-photo-to-video`](../../product-photo-to-video/README.md): truth sheet, cut-out, hero still, storyboard sheet, one multi-shot Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4 clip, real packshot on the last second. The other 3 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill product-photo-to-video --skill varg-product-lock --skill varg-unboxing-video --skill varg-product-hook
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Turn these three photos of my water bottle into a 12-second 9:16 product video: macro condensation, ice pour, packshot. ./bottle/"*

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `product-photo-to-video`: ~$2.50–10 per 15 s 720p video incl. one repaired shot (estimate).
- `varg-product-lock`: ~$0.05 per clip drift check (video_analyze).
- `varg-unboxing-video`: ~$3.85 per 10 s 720p clip with audio (tested).
- `varg-product-hook`: ~$2.31 per 6 s 720p Seedance 2.5 clip (tested).
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can AI make a product video from just a photo?

Yes, from one to three photos: product-photo-to-video writes a product truth sheet (label text letter by letter), makes a cut-out and a hero still, an 8-12 panel storyboard sheet, then one multi-shot Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4 clip with a PRODUCT LOCK block. It never ships a Ken Burns slideshow.

### Why does my logo or label melt in AI video?

It is the #1 tell in AI product ads. varg-product-lock fixes geometry and surface in a lock sheet, passes 2-4 angles as references, climbs a camera-risk ladder (locked frame, push-in, slide, small orbit), bans risky motion words and composites the real packshot where text must be exact.

### How do I make an ASMR unboxing video with AI?

varg-unboxing-video writes hands-only, top-down or POV shots in timed VISUAL / ACTION / SOUND blocks on Seedance 2.5, with native ASMR sound (taps, crinkle, lid pop) and no music.

### Can I make a viral hook clip from product photos?

Yes. varg-product-hook generates a realistic UGC-style clip of the product in use (a torture test, problem then solution, a gift reaction) or remakes a hook that already went viral for that kind of product.

### Does it work for clothes?

Apparel try-on is one format here, but to put a garment on a model and keep it intact use varg-tryon-video.
